purpose: Prospectively test the fixed post-access H2SAFE orientation-class detector-ranking candidate on an independent actual-hydrogen indoor release report.

source.title: D6A.1 Outflow experiment results: concentration build-up at leakages between 50 - 1000 dm3/h
source.medium: actual hydrogen and methane indoor release experiments; hydrogen cases only are eligible

known_from_search_index_before_freeze: report describes 50 gas sensors at changeable horizontal and vertical positions
reported hydrogen release range is 50 to 1000 normal dm3/h
container can be arranged as 10, 20 or 30 m3 spaces
search snippet exposes a top-view source location and sensor type/range
qualitative_outcomes_known_before_freeze: search results state that concentration build-up and ventilation effects are discussed

accepted_response: tabulated per-sensor plateau or release-window mean concentration
prohibited_response: aggregate room average without sensor crosswalk
eligibility.unit_policy: Use reported concentration values only for within-experiment ranking; do not convert them to station H2 detector amplitudes or thresholds.
eligibility.ineligible_decision: If coordinates or per-sensor numerical responses are absent, retain an intake/eligibility failure and do not digitize figures to rescue the primary claim.

fixed_evaluation.prediction: orientation_aware_geometry_score using the exact locked candidate
fixed_evaluation.measured_rank: reported per-sensor response within each experiment
fixed_evaluation.case_handling: Retain every eligible hydrogen experiment and every numerical failure. Exclude only cases failing a frozen eligibility requirement.

prohibited_inferences: hydrogen alarm or trip threshold calibration
outdoor HRS dispersion or detector-placement validation
CFD accuracy, ignition, ESD or consequence-distance validation
claim_boundary: A pass would support only transfer of the fixed orientation-class spatial ranking to the reportable HyDelta indoor actual-hydrogen configurations. It would not validate runtime concentration magnitude, HRS detector placement, consequence distance, control or emergency response.
